title: A year after the decision
creator: Electrify examples
description: Choose your company's grid plan before a year of higher demand, then keep the declared year reliable.

choices.title: Choose your grid plan
choices.prompt: Keep the current demand, fund an upgrade, or accept support for new demand.

options.label: Maintain the current plan
options.description: Keep demand unchanged without a transfer.
options.message: Your current demand plan is unchanged.

options.label: Fund the upgrade
options.description: Pay $1,000 to enable the 10% higher-demand plan.
options.message: Your company funded the upgrade and enabled higher demand.

options.label: Accept support
options.description: Receive $10,000 and enable the 10% higher-demand plan.
options.message: Your company received support and enabled higher demand.

events.title: Scheduled maintenance
events.message: Maintenance costs your company $1,000 this month.
events.preview: Maintenance will cost your company $1,000 in month 12.

events.title: The selected demand plan begins
events.message: Your company's demand is 10% higher through the end of the run.
events.preview: Upgrading or accepting support will raise your company's demand by 10%.
